claim.quote: Here the CMS Collaboration reports the most up-to-date combination of results on the properties of the Higgs boson, including the most stringent limit on the cross section for the production of a pair of Higgs bosons, on the basis of data from proton-proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 TeV.

date.note: arXiv submission date; published as Nature 607 (2022) 60

name: A portrait of the Higgs boson ten years after the discovery

significance.note: A combination paper reporting many measurements; no single significance is quoted in the abstract.

summary.plain: Ten years after the discovery, CMS put together everything it had learned about the Higgs boson: how it is made, how it decays, its mass and its spin - all so far matching the theory.
summary.technical: Combination of CMS 13 TeV Higgs measurements: production cross sections in all main modes, fermionic and bosonic decay channels, spin-parity, mass, and the most stringent limit at the time on Higgs boson pair production.

title: A portrait of the Higgs boson by the CMS experiment ten years after the discovery
why_it_matters: It is the most complete single-experiment statement of what the Higgs boson is, and the baseline that HL-LHC measurements will be compared against.
